Loss report: drone -> gitea
[lost] pipeline/drone/job/deploy job.environment (Gitea ignores jobs.<id>.environment)
[external] pipeline/drone/job/deploy job.environment.approval: configure required reviewers on the environment in repository settings
[emulated] pipeline/drone job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/deploy job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/deploy step.action: actions/checkout step (Drone clones the repository before the steps (https://docs.drone.io/pipeline/docker/syntax/cloning/); clone.depth maps to the step input, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/deploy/step/deploy step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
[emulated] pipeline/drone/trigger/0 trigger.push: branches: '**' (GHA fires a push without filters for branches and tags; branches are named explicitly to leave tags out or beside a tag filter)
[native] pipeline/drone/job/deploy/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
